description: Implements the SASLprep profile (RFC4013) of the stringprep algorithm (RFC3454) for processing strings within the PDFsharp library, specifically in the security encryption namespace.

classes.name: SASLprep
classes.description: Provides static methods to process strings according to the SASLprep profile, including mapping, normalization, and bidirectional character checks.

methods.name: PrepareStoredString
methods.description: Prepares a string for storage by applying SASLprep rules, prohibiting unassigned code points.

methods.name: PrepareQuery
methods.description: Prepares a string for query purposes by applying SASLprep rules, allowing unassigned code points.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Core method that performs mapping, normalization, prohibited character checks, and bidirectional character validation based on the allowUnassignedCodepoints flag.
